page.layout: One column of dictionary entries in roman type, with Hebrew headwords and Hebrew forms; page number top right; Hebrew running head top centre; Hebrew catchword bottom right; no marginal notes.

main_text.p: עָר m. Inimicus, Adversarius, quasi, In malum alterius Vigilans: Aff. עָרְךָ Inimicus tuus, 1.Sam.28.16. Plural. עָרֶיךָ Adversarios tuos, Mich.5.14. Sic Psal.139.20. Chald. לְעָרֶיךָ Inimicis tuis, Dan.4.16. Possit plane esse Chaldaicum pro Hebraeo צַר, per commutationem usitatam ׂ ז in ע. Masora ölo[?] in hoc sensu adducit, Mich.5.
עָיִר m. Caecus, Exod.4.11. Plural. עִוְרִים Jesa.29.18. Foemin. עִוְרָה Caeca: Plural. עִוְרוֹת Jesa.42.7.
עוּשׁ Coire, Convenire, Congregari: Imper. עוּשׁוּ Coite, Congregate vos, Joel.3.11.
עֵשׁ mafc. Arcturus: Plaustrum septem stellarum Congregatarum, quae nunquam separantur, juxta Aben Esram, Job.9.9. Aliam significationem vide in עָשׁ [?].
עָיִשׁ m. Idem, Job.38.32. Talmudici זְנַב טָלֶה [?] Caudam arietis definiunt, Cod. Berachoth cap.9. fol.58.

עוּת Pih. עוֹת Pervertit, Subvertit: Praeteritum, אֵת אֲשֶׁר עִוָּתוֹ [?] Quod perverterit ipse, Eccl.7.14. עוֹתַנִי Subvertit me, Job.19.6. Pyh. Partic. מְעוֹת Perver-sum, Eccles.1.15. Hithp. Praeter. וְהִתְעַוּתוּ Et pervertunt sese, Eccles.12.3.
עַוָּתָה f. Perversitas: Aff. עַוָּתִי Perversitatem meam, Thren.3.59.
עֵז f. Capra, Num.15.27. Plural. עִזִּים Caprae, Gen.27.9. Aff. וְעִזְּךָ Et capra tua, Genes.31.v.38. Chald. עִזִּין Caprae, Esr.6.17.

* עֲזָאזֵל Hafaiel, nomen hirci in desertum emissi cum peccatis populi, quasi Hircus abiens aut oberrans dictus, ab עַז & אָזַל Abiit, Lev.16.8. vel secundum Hebraeos, Nomen loci, ab hirco ipso sic dicti.

page.notes: Running head and catchword are Hebrew letters and were read with doubt. Several Hebrew vowel-pointed forms (עוּת, עִוָּתוֹ, עֲזָאזֵל, טָלֶה) are uncertain at this scan resolution. "ölo" after "Masora" is not clearly legible. Printed "Mafora" was read as "Masora". Long s was normalised to s throughout. No marginal notes are printed on this page.
